function clearActive() {
  document.body.classList.remove('nav-hover');
  menuItems.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
  contents.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
}

const resetActiveContents = () => {

function activateByTarget(target) {

  const item = [...menuItems].find(li =>
    li.querySelector(`[data-target="${target}"]`)
  );

  const content = document.querySelector(`.megamenu-content[data-content="${target}"]`);

  clearActive();

  document.body.classList.add('nav-hover');

  if (item) {
    item.classList.add('active');
  }

  if (content) {
    content.classList.add('active');
  }

(function () {
  const track = document.getElementById('logoTrack');
  const originals = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('img'));

  function setup() {
    // Remove all previous clones
    track.querySelectorAll('img[aria-hidden]').forEach(el => el.remove());

    // Wait for all original images to load before measuring
    Promise.all(
      originals.map(img =>
        img.complete
          ? Promise.resolve()
          : new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.onerror = r; })
      )
    ).then(() => {
      const gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 88;

      // Sum of all image widths + one gap per image (including trailing gap)
      // The trailing gap ensures the loop point is seamless — no snap
      const setWidth = originals.reduce((sum, img) => {
        return sum + img.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      }, 0) + gap * originals.length;

      // Minimum 2 sets for loop; add more sets to always fill viewport on wide/4K screens
      const setsNeeded = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(window.innerWidth / setWidth) + 1);

      // Append cloned sets
      for (let i = 1; i < setsNeeded; i++) {
        originals.forEach(img => {
          const clone = img.cloneNode(true);

      // Set the exact translate distance = one set width
      track.style.setProperty('--set-width', `${setWidth}px`);
